watches.name: *Limited Edition* 38mm Automatic Standard Issue Field Watch with Date: Textured Latte Dial
watches.description: One of our favorite colors from the Weiss collection takes on a new form. Latte has long been part of our 38mm Standard collection. For this limited edition, Cameron has returned to the familiar color with a new approach, introducing a textured dial alongside black hands featuring lume and luminous numerals, not found on our standard Latte Dial. A small flash of orange brings “Nashville” to the dial, a nod to the city where each Weiss timepiece is completed. The inspiration behind Latte has always been simple: the everyday ritual of making coffee. The warmth of the color, the few quiet minutes spent making it, and the familiarity of something you return to each morning. It’s an ordinary part of the day that, with a little attention, becomes a ritual of its own. This limited edition builds on that original idea while giving Latte a distinctly different character. The textured surface brings added depth to the dial, while the black hands and luminous details create a stronger contrast than our standard Latte offering. It’s a new interpretation of a color that has become a familiar part of Weiss, while preserving the versatile 38mm proportions that made the original Latte a staple of our collection. Housed in a 38mm stainless steel case and powered by our automatic movement, each timepiece is individually numbered and completed to order in our Nashville workshop. A familiar Weiss color, seen differently. Each watch is paired with a black leather strap handcrafted in Nashville. Soft from the start, the leather quickly forms to the wrist and develops character with regular wear. Like all Weiss timepieces, each piece is assembled individually in small production runs in our Nashville workshop, with a focus on long-term serviceability and daily use. Individually handcrafted. Order now for anticipated holiday delivery. Finished and assembled by hand in our Nashville workshop, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is a 2892A2 base automatic movement, seamlessly blending robust functionality with refined design. Water-resistant up to 300 feet, it features a sweeping seconds hand and a custom date wheel that complements the dial. With a 42-hour power reserve, this timepiece is built to endure. Sapphire crystal highlights the intricate movement, encased in stainless steel, with black hands and a black seconds hand. Each timepiece is paired with a Black Leather strap handcrafted in Nashville. Edition: Latte Textured Nashville dial, limited to 50 pieces in total, each model marked X/50 Movement: Weiss Watch Company Caliber 2130, 2892A2 base mechanical movement, finished and assembled by hand in Nashville. Made of domestic and foreign components. Each watch is assembled by hand in our Nashville workshop in small production runs using the Weiss Caliber 2130 automatic movement. The 38mm case size wears comfortably across a wide range of wrists while maintaining the proportions and legibility that have become central to the Weiss design. Each dial takes on a different character depending on the strap, light, and wear over time. Lumed numerals, stainless steel hands, and BGW9 lume keep the design clean and highly legible without feeling overly precious or overly technical. The inspiration behind the Automatic Issue collection came from old field watches, analog instrumentation, workshop equipment, and the kinds of objects that quietly become part of daily life through regular use. Each watch is paired with a handcrafted strap made in Nashville using carefully selected materials chosen to soften, wear in, and develop character naturally over time. Finished and assembled by hand in Nashville, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is based on the 2892A2 automatic movement and features a screw-down crown, custom date wheel, Incabloc shock protection, and 42-hour power reserve. Designed with long-term serviceability in mind, every watch is built to be maintained, worn often, and passed down. Individually handcrafted. Order now for anticipated holiday delivery. An automatic watch, meticulously crafted for both adventure and elegance. The Weiss Caliber 2130 features refined details like a screw-down crown, custom date mechanism, and Incabloc shock protection, all housed in an incredibly lightweight design. Whether you’re navigating the ocean or transitioning to the boardroom, this timepiece combines durability with timeless sophistication, embodying the active yet refined lifestyle of its creator, Cameron Weiss. Finished and assembled by hand in our Nashville workshop, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is an 2892A2-based automatic movement, seamlessly blending robust functionality with refined design. Water-resistant up to 300 feet, it features a sweeping seconds hand and a custom date wheel that complements the dial. With a 42-hour power reserve, this timepiece is built to endure. Sapphire crystal highlights the intricate movement, encased in stainless steel, with black oxide-treated hands and a hand-painted naval brass dial. Each timepiece is paired with a hand-stitched strap, selected to complement your style. watches.name: 42mm Automatic Standard Issue Field Watch with Date - Black Dial
watches.description: The 42mm Automatic Issue Field Watch was designed as a larger, more modern interpretation of the Weiss field watch. It is highly legible, lightweight on the wrist, and built for daily wear. The watch balances clean dial design with subtle functional details including a matching date wheel, black oxide-treated hands, applied numerals, and BGW9 Super-LumiNova for low-light visibility. The design takes inspiration from old field watches, analog instrumentation, workshop tools, and the kinds of objects that become more familiar and personal through regular use. The 42mm case gives the watch a stronger wrist presence while still maintaining the restraint central to the Weiss design. Each timepiece is assembled individually in our Nashville workshop in small production runs using the Weiss Caliber 2130 automatic movement. Based on the 2892A2, the movement features a screw-down crown, Incabloc shock protection, 42-hour power reserve, and water resistance up to 300 feet. The 42mm Automatic Issue was designed to feel versatile without becoming overly technical or overly polished. It is equally at home worn daily, traveling, outdoors, or in the workshop itself. Each timepiece is paired with a handcrafted strap made in Nashville, designed to soften, wear in, and develop character naturally over time. Individually handcrafted. Order now for anticipated holiday delivery. An automatic watch with a sleek, modern update. Inspired by Cameron Weiss’ active lifestyle, the Company Caliber 2130 features game-changing details like a screw-down crown, date, automatic mechanism, incabloc shock protection, and an incredibly lightweight design. To put it simply, it’s a watch that’ll take you from surfing to spearfishing and back to the office with ease. Finished and assembled by hand, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is a 2892-A2 base, finished and assembled by hand based automatic movement. Water-resistant (up to 300 feet to be exact) and ultra-light, it features new details like a sweeping seconds and a custom dial-matching date wheel. With a solid 42-hour power reserve, it's designed to last – and look good doing it. Sapphire crystals accentuate the back, while stainless steel completes the case. The hands are finished in black oxide treated steel with white super-luminova BGW9 paint. And the dial? It boasts hand-painted, timeless naval brass. Each timepiece comes with one hand-stitched strap of your choice. watches.name: *Limited Edition* Titanium 38mm Standard Issue Field Watch: Textured Sierra Green
watches.description: From the Sierras. Built in Nashville. Sierra Green has a personal connection to the earliest days of Weiss. When Cameron was first building the company, there were stretches when parts would finally become available and he would work through the night making watches. When the parts ran out and there was finally time to step away, Cameron and Whitney would head for the mountains, camping and exploring Sierra National Forest, Sequoia National Park, and Kings Canyon. Sierra Green draws from those trips and the landscape that gave them a chance to reset, particularly the deep greens of the towering Sequoias and the perspective that comes from standing beneath them. 20 pieces are in-stock and ready to ship A Dial Drawn from Experience Individually hand-painted on naval brass, the textured Sierra Green dial brings that landscape to the wrist. High-polish silver applied metal numerals and silver-finished hands are filled with latte Super-LumiNova, creating clear legibility during the day and a warm glow after dark. Built for Daily Wear A lightweight 38mm titanium case, luminous hands and numerals, manual-wind movement, and English Tan leather strap give the Sierra Green the utility of a field watch with a story rooted in the places Cameron returned to when it was time to step away from the bench. Limited Edition Each Sierra Green is completed in our Nashville workshop and individually numbered as x/50 part of this limited edition collection of 50 units. The Next Chapter of American Watchmaking Weiss Watch Company was founded by American watchmaker Cameron Weiss with a clear purpose: to advance the practice of mechanical watchmaking in the United States. Each Sierra Green is assembled, finished, regulated, and tested in our Nashville workshop using American-made and imported components. For more than a decade, we have documented that work openly—from movement and component manufacturing to finishing, assembly, regulation, and service. The next chapter of American watchmaking is being built in Nashville—one watch at a time. The Sierra Green pairs a lightweight 38mm titanium case with an individually hand-painted naval-brass dial, silver-finished hands filled with latte Super-LumiNova, and sapphire crystals at the front and back. At its center is the Weiss Watch Company Caliber 1005, built on a Swiss 7001 base and finished and assembled by hand in our Nashville workshop. The watch is completed with an English Tan leather strap crafted from Horween leather and lined with Haas Novonappa Gold leather. Hand-stitched and selected to develop a distinctive patina over time, the leather becomes increasingly personal with wear. Movement: Weiss Watch Company Caliber 1005 mechanical movement, built on a Swiss 7001 base and finished and assembled by hand in Nashville. Functions: Manual winding; hours, minutes, and small seconds at 6 o’clock; 21,600 vibrations per hour; approximately 42-hour power reserve; Incabloc shock protection. Case: Titanium; 38mm diameter; 46.2mm lug-to-lug; 10.7mm thick, including crystal. watches.name: *Limited Edition* 42mm Automatic Standard Issue Field Watch with Date: Textured White Dial
watches.description: One of our most requested dials returns in the 42mm Automatic Standard Issue Field Watch with Date. Limited to just 50 pieces, this marks only the second time we've produced the textured white dial in the larger 42mm case. Finished with applied numerals, black hands, a black seconds hand, and our orange "Nashville, TN" signature, every detail was chosen to add warmth and depth to an otherwise restrained design. The dial changes constantly with the light. Indoors, the texture softens and nearly disappears. In direct sun, the grain becomes much more pronounced, revealing a surface that feels almost raw and industrial. Cameron has always been drawn to objects that become better with use: worn leather, old machinery, faded gauges, workshop tools, and vintage camera bodies. The textured white dial came from that same instinct. It doesn't try to feel polished or overly precious. It feels tactile, mechanical, and meant to be worn. Each watch is paired with a tan suede strap handcrafted in Nashville using CF Stead leather from England. Soft from the start, the suede quickly forms to the wrist and develops character with regular wear. Like all Weiss timepieces, each piece is assembled individually in small production runs in our Nashville workshop, with a focus on long-term serviceability and daily use. Individually handcrafted and expected to ship in 8–10 weeks. Finished and assembled by hand in our Nashville workshop, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is a 2892A2 base automatic movement, seamlessly blending robust functionality with refined design. Water-resistant up to 300 feet, it features a sweeping seconds hand and a custom date wheel that complements the dial. With a 42-hour power reserve, this timepiece is built to endure. Sapphire crystal highlights the intricate movement, encased in stainless steel, with black hands and a black seconds hand. Each timepiece is paired with an Alden Snuff suede strap handcrafted in Nashville. Edition: Nashville dial, limited to 50 pieces in total, each model marked X/50 Movement: Weiss Watch Company Caliber 2130, 2892A2 base mechanical movement, finished and assembled by hand in Nashville. Made of domestic and foreign components. watches.name: 42mm Automatic Standard Issue Field Watch with Date - White Dial
watches.description: The 42mm Automatic Issue Field Watch was designed as a larger, more modern interpretation of the Weiss field watch. It is highly legible, lightweight on the wrist, and built for daily wear. The watch balances clean dial design with subtle functional details including a matching date wheel, black oxide-treated hands, applied numerals, and BGW9 Super-LumiNova for low-light visibility. The design takes inspiration from old field watches, analog instrumentation, workshop tools, and the kinds of objects that become more familiar and personal through regular use. The 42mm case gives the watch a stronger wrist presence while still maintaining the restraint central to the Weiss design. Each timepiece is assembled individually in our Nashville workshop in small production runs using the Weiss Caliber 2130 automatic movement. Based on the 2892A2, the movement features a screw-down crown, Incabloc shock protection, 42-hour power reserve, and water resistance up to 300 feet. The 42mm Automatic Issue was designed to feel versatile without becoming overly technical or overly polished. It is equally at home worn daily, traveling, outdoors, or in the workshop itself. Each timepiece is paired with a handcrafted strap made in Nashville, designed to soften, wear in, and develop character naturally over time. Individually handcrafted. Order now for anticipated holiday delivery. An automatic watch with a sleek, modern update. Inspired by Cameron Weiss’ active lifestyle, the Company Caliber 2130 features game-changing details like a screw-down crown, date, automatic mechanism, incabloc shock protection, and an incredibly lightweight design. To put it simply, it’s a watch that’ll take you from surfing to spearfishing and back to the office with ease. Finished and assembled by hand, the Weiss Caliber 2130 is a 2892-A2 base, finished and assembled by hand based automatic movement. Water-resistant (up to 300 feet to be exact) and ultra-light, it features new details like a sweeping seconds and a custom dial-matching date wheel. With a solid 42-hour power reserve, it's designed to last – and look good doing it. Sapphire crystals accentuate the back, while stainless steel completes the case. The hands are finished in black oxide treated steel with white super-luminova BGW9 paint. And the dial? It boasts hand-painted, timeless naval brass. Each timepiece comes with one hand-stitched strap of your choice.
